surfaces.mechanism_doc: GET /api/trpc/usageAnalytics.getSummary
surfaces.notes: Not built (lane ENTAPI-L16D, T-713, decision): a whole-window KPI card. Its additive members (cost, requests, tokens, errors) are the sums of kilo.analytics.table over the same window, and the rest are ratios and averages derived from those sums (errorRate, avgLatencyMs, cacheHitRatio and so on) or a window-wide distinct user count that is not additive across runs. Landing it would add a second copy of the table's numbers at a grain (the run's window) no fact key can hold. The latency totals are the one thing the table does not carry; they wait for a decision on a latency fact.
